name: Project Manager Dialog
description: Edits Project identity and Folder membership in one reviewed modal without moving platform effects into Workbench.

states: Open Manage Project for a one-Folder Project and confirm that no redundant primary designation or Set Primary action appears.
Open a multi-Folder Project, hover or focus a non-primary Folder, and inspect the raised Set Primary action and full-path Tooltip.
Choose Add Folder in browser composition and confirm that only the final list row becomes a path field with compact Cancel and Add icon actions whose Tooltips show their keyboard hints.
Open Manage Project, choose Add Folder, and confirm that native acquisition commits the selected Folder without replacing the final row with a manual path field.
With SSH attachment available, choose Add Folder and inspect the explicit Local and SSH actions without closing the Project manager.
Inspect the appended native Folder and published SSH-marked remote Folder while the Project-name draft, primary Folder, existing Workspace defaults, and outer Dialog actions remain stable.

useWhen: A person needs to rename a Workbench Project or inspect, add, and remove its Folder membership.
Folder acquisition must remain inside the Project management context instead of opening an unrelated flow.
avoidWhen: The person is creating a new Project from its first Folder; use the Project create flow.
The requested change belongs only to one Workspace and does not alter Project-owned Folder membership.
invariants: The Project name draft is committed only by the outer Save action and cancellation preserves the existing name.
A one-Folder Project omits primary-folder designation and selection controls because the choice is implicit.
For a multi-Folder Project, only non-primary rows reveal Set Primary on row hover or keyboard focus, using a raised action surface.
Hovering or focusing a Folder name exposes its complete path through the shared Tooltip.
Browser Folder entry replaces only the final Add Folder row while the surrounding list and outer Dialog actions remain stable.
Adding a Folder validates empty and exact duplicate browser paths before invoking the semantic action.
Native Folder acquisition keeps the list stable, admits one request, and rechecks the latest Project and exact duplicate paths before invoking the semantic action.
Native cancellation, bounded failure, disposal, and late completion do not alter Folder membership.
SSH attachment receives only the exact Project identity; every canonically published Environment Folder has a localized visible and accessible SSH marker while local Folders remain unmarked.
Removing the primary Folder automatically falls back to the next remaining Folder without asking for a replacement.
